![What's new in Hamstr 0.5.0](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mailo037/Hamstr/v0.5.0/docs/images/releases/v0.5.0.png)

Hamstr 0.5.0 brings playlists, picks videos out of shared playlists and whole Cineby seasons, and ships **Cheek 0.2.1**.

- **Playlists** of your own: make one from a file's menu (**Add to playlist**) or from a selection in the library, then play it in order or shuffled, rename it, take files off or delete it. Deleting a playlist keeps its files. Downloaded playlists show up there too, as a row on top of the library.
- **Share a playlist, album or channel** and Hamstr lists its videos to tick off, with one quality for all of them. Videos you already have start unticked, private and deleted ones are marked. Each picked video becomes its own download, grouped in Stash with **Pause all** and **Resume all**.
- **Cineby and CineSrc series and seasons**, such as `https://cineby.rocks/tv/40075?season=2`, open an episode picker. One episode shows its qualities as usual; several (or the whole season) are queued together. Instant stash opens the picker for these links too.
- **Plain file links** (a ZIP, PDF, APK, installer and the like) download as they are, without being treated as media.
- **Held sideways**, the tabs and the mini player move into a side bar on the left, so the screens keep the full height.
- **Open when done** (Settings) brings Hamstr up playing the file once the last download is in. Android needs "Display over other apps" for that.
- Notifications use your accent color.
- **Cheek 0.2.1** is bundled: a paused download keeps its progress when the number of parallel downloads changed in the meantime. Before, it started over.

Install over the previous release or use Settings → About. APK signatures use the same release key; verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
